title: Townsend Brown and the Caroline Group
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown and the Caroline Group, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then Townsend Brown also runs into this sort of, you know, the Caroline Group, this international group of industrialists that seem to suck up all of the exotic tech.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the inventor Townsend Brown came up against something called the Caroline Group. Michels describes it as an international group of industrialists that seems to soak up all the exotic technology. If true, it would mean unusual inventions were being quietly gathered up by private powers.
